description: This Rust source file defines a client for interacting with a data broker service using protobuf and gRPC. It includes methods for retrieving metadata, datapoints, setting datapoints, subscribing to updates, and updating datapoints, along with associated data structures and external dependencies.

classes.name: SDVClient
classes.description: A client wrapper for interacting with the data broker service, providing methods to fetch and manipulate data asynchronously.

methods.name: new(uri: Uri) -> Self
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SDVClient with the specified URI.

methods.name: get_metadata( &mut self, paths: Vec<String>, ) -> Result<Vec<proto::v1::Metadata>, ClientError>
methods.description: Fetches metadata for specified property paths from the broker.

methods.name: get_datapoints( &mut self, paths: Vec<impl AsRef<str>>, ) -> Result< HashMap<std::string::String, databroker_proto::sdv::databroker::v1::Datapoint>, ClientError, >
methods.description: Retrieves datapoints for given paths, returning a hashmap of datapoint objects keyed by string.

methods.name: set_datapoints( &mut self, datapoints: HashMap<String, proto::v1::Datapoint>, ) -> Result<proto::v1::SetDatapointsReply, ClientError>
methods.description: Sets multiple datapoints in the broker, returning a reply indicating success or failure.

methods.name: subscribe( &mut self, query: String, ) -> Result<tonic::Streaming<proto::v1::SubscribeReply>, ClientError>
methods.description: Subscribes to a stream of updates matching a query string.

methods.name: update_datapoints( &mut self, datapoints: HashMap<i32, proto::v1::Datapoint>, ) -> Result<proto::v1::UpdateDatapointsReply, ClientError>
methods.description: Updates datapoints with new values, using a hashmap with integer keys.
